request: Build a small Jac web app for tracking personal expenses. An expense has a title, an amount, a category and a date. The user can add, edit and delete expenses, see the total for the current month, and see totals per category for a chosen month. Keep the expense rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Amounts must be positive; an expense with a zero or negative amount is rejected.
The monthly total is the sum of that month's expenses only.
Per-category totals for a month add up to that month's total.
Editing an expense updates the totals.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
